text: Beating Retreat Ceremony LIVE | India's Armed Forces Showcase Musical Prowess in Grand FinaleThe annual Beating Retreat ceremony is underway at the historic Vijay Chowk in New Delhi, formally marking the conclusion of India's Republic Day festivities. President Droupadi Murmu, the Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces, is presiding over the event, which features a spectacular display of military precision and musical grandeur. Massed bands of the Indian Army, Navy, Air Force, and the Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) are performing a series of stirring martial tunes and classic compositions before the national flag is lowered at sunset, bringing the four-day celebrations to a solemn and majestic close. #BeatingRetreat #RepublicDay #IndianArmy #IndianNavy #IndianAirForce #PresidentMurmu #NewDelhi #VijayChowk #MilitaryBands #IncredibleIndia #timesnow Times Now - Times Now News channel examines news with in-depth analysis.
